name: flyrank-context
title_zh: 面试题里藏着公司史，先读这份再动手写代码
tagline_zh: FlyRank 的 ML 实习题总绕不开“旗子”和“打败规则”。这份背景把产品逻辑、搜索痛点。
tagline_en: FlyRank's ML tasks always mention flags and beating rules. This context explains the product, the search pain.
desc_en: FlyRank-specific background — what the company does, the search problem, and the hand-written flags story that the ML internship work builds on. Load for context when an assignment references FlyRank's product, flags, or the "beat the rule" framing. (Project-specific: delete this folder when reusing the skill library elsewhere.)
why_zh: 它把散在代码、文档、会议里的公司叙事收拢成一份上下文，让实习生在动手前先对齐“为什么有这道题”。
why_en: It consolidates FlyRank's scattered product lore into one context, aligning you with the why before you dive into the how—so.
limit_zh: 只服务 FlyRank 的 ML 实习场景；题目若不涉及旗子、搜索排序或“打败规则”的叙事，这份背景就是冗余。
limit_en: Only for FlyRank ML internship tasks about flags, search ranking, or the 'beat the rule' narrative. Irrelevant elsewhere—delete this folder when.
title_en: Company backstory for interview tasks—read before you code
